blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur— Student leaders and child representatives traded classrooms for Butuan City Hall offices on Wednesday, temporarily assuming the posts of local officials and department heads during the city’s observance of the Children’s Day of Governance. Leading the youth officials as “Little City Mayor” was Jheff Ymann Reyes, president of the Supreme Secondary Learner Government (SSLG) at Agusan National High School. In a statement issued by the Public Information Office, Reyes—a first-time participant—described the immersion as an eye-opener into the daily demands of public administration, noting that he intends to bring executive and legislative lessons back to his […]...
